evidence: Four versioned flow modules preserve physical and simulation contracts with bounded inputs.
The service advertises runner-compatible schemas and isolates native service URLs from workflow input.
Timeouts, payload ceilings, mock-by-default command gating, and bounded synchronous datasets fail closed.
Runtime, catalog, HTTP smoke, benchmark, and bounded soak checks cover every module.
Non-root read-only container, no capabilities, internal networking, pinned builder and CI scanning are configured.
Inputs, outputs, target systems, safe mock workflow, limits, and failure handling are documented.
